pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions exhibiting smooth pixel gradients at the edges due to image resolution and blur. Spatial area of patches is larger on the upper torso and diminishes significantly toward the lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned pathways forming a continuous topological network between patches. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. The thickness of these pathways remains relatively uniform across the visible mid-section.
